[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]An unofficial update to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/551?tab=description]JamieDepledge's Pusheen cat replacer[/url] to work with Content Patcher. Unlike the other port, this one has zero changes for those who prefer the original.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Install the same as any other mod.[/color]

[size=4][b]Disclaimer[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]The original mod was made by and belongs to JamieDepledge. This is just an unofficial update to make it function on modern versions. If the mod author sees this and wishes it to be removed, contact me and I will do so.[/color]
